hooks.command: sh -c 'umask 077; R="$1"; D="$HOME/.claude/.cowork-mem"; L="$D/capture-errors.log"; mkdir -p "$D" 2>/dev/null; chmod 700 "$D" 2>/dev/null; chmod 600 "$D"/memory.db* "$L"* 2>/dev/null; COWORK_MEM_DB="$D/memory.db" python3 "$R/skills/cowork-mem/scripts/post_tool_capture.py" 2>/dev/null || { rc=$?; echo "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ) [cowork-mem] HOOK FAILED exit=$rc script=$R/skills/cowork-mem/scripts/post_tool_capture.py" >>"$L" 2>/dev/null; [ -n "$(find "$L" -size +256k 2>/dev/null)" ] && mv -f "$L" "$L.1" 2>/dev/null; }; exit 0' _ "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"
